explanation: I found no Mathlib lemma stating |arsinh x| ≤ |x|. In `Mathlib/Analysis/SpecialFunctions/Arsinh.lean`, the only order lemmas for `arsinh` are `arsinh_le_arsinh`, `arsinh_lt_arsinh` and the sign lemmas (`arsinh_nonneg_iff`, `arsinh_nonpos_iff`, …). There is also no `abs_arsinh` lemma. `DerivHyp.lean` has `abs_sinh` and `self_le_sinh_iff` for `sinh`, but getting the `arsinh` bound from them needs a case split on the sign of x, oddness of `arsinh`, and moving through `sinh`/`arsinh` monotonicity. That is more than one or two lines of glue. I searched for the names `abs_arsinh*`, `arsinh_le*`, `arsinh_lt*`, every `≤` statement involving `arsinh`, and the related `sinh` bounds.
